karen (Vendor Ops): Quick supplier onboarding + invoice remit update for folks who manage vendors. Pls RT to anyone owning vendor relationships.
karen (Vendor Ops): Effective immediately: new remit address + preferred invoice metadata fields. Remit must include vendor_id, PO number (if any), and expense_code. Missing fields will delay payment.
matt (Finance Ops): New remit address: payments@redwood-invoicing.com (use PDF invoices only). Scanned screenshots are accepted only temporarily if you upload the vendor PDF within 48h.
hiro (Legal): Note: any vendor handling customer data needs a signed DPA before payment. If a vendor invoices before DPA is executed, tag legal-review in the procurement form.
karen (Vendor Ops): We've added a short onboarding checklist in the playbook: 1) Vendor profile in Coupa. 2) Add vendor_id provided by Vendor Ops. 3) Attach SOW/PO or authorization. 4) Include expense_code in invoice. Link: https://confluence.redwood/procurement/onboarding
acct-bot: Automation: New vendor form -> https://confluence.redwood/procurement/new-vendor | Invoice template -> https://confluence.redwood/procurement/invoice-template.xlsx
sasha (Eng): Small Q: our infra contractor invoices weekly without PO. Do they need vendor_id now?
karen (Vendor Ops): Yes @sasha, every external supplier should have a vendor_id. For recurring contractors we can set up a vendor profile and assign a standing PO. If urgent, use temporary vendor_id and followup with the full profile within 5 business days.
matt (Finance Ops): Also changing expense_code taxonomy slightly: we now have separate infra/runtime vs infra-capex codes. See the taxonomy page in the playbook and pick the closest match. If unsure, use "infra-misc" and finance will reclassify post-upload.
sasha (Eng): Got it. For standing POs, what is the SLA to create the PO?
karen (Vendor Ops): Standard SLA: 3 business days for standing PO for known vendors. For infra-critical recurring costs mark "priority-po" and DM me; we can do 24h triage during business hours.
hiro (Legal): Reminder: no team should sign a vendor contract with auto-renewal + data processing before Legal signs off. If you see an invoice for an auto-renewed contract without Legal signoff, pause payment and tag legal-review.
matt (Finance Ops): Practical tip: Add vendor_id and PO number in the invoice filename when you upload to Coupa. This speeds matching and avoids duplicate vendors.
akct-bot: Oops typo in bot name
acct-bot: Correction: use acct-bot for automated reminders.
acct-bot: Quick checklist snippet: "Vendor onboarding: vendor_id, PO (if present), PDF invoice, expense_code, DPA if applicable". Full doc: https://confluence.redwood/procurement/onboarding#remit
karen (Vendor Ops): We'll run a remediation sweep next week to add vendor_ids to legacy suppliers. If you own a legacy supplier please respond in this thread with vendor name + last invoice date.
sasha (Eng): We'll post ours: EmbeddingCo - last invoice 2025-02-15.
matt (Finance Ops): Thanks folks. I'll drop a 1-pager in #general and run two 20-min office hours Wed/Thu to help with legacy vendor mapping. Ping me if you need an expedited vendor_id. :wave:
